status: pre-registered before the final 20-seed confirmatory run; exploratory feature analysis informed the feature set and is disclosed

splits.company_disjoint_test: test companies with no dev/validation claims, n=108

features: company history n and bucket distribution (outcomes public before cutoff)
previous guidance growth and width (public at its own cutoff)

model.preprocessing: median imputation + standardization; most-frequent imputation + one-hot for sector
model.selection: GroupKFold(5) by company on dev+validation; C in {0.1,1,10}; class_weight in {None,balanced}; selected by grouped-CV macro F1

uncertainty.training_bootstrap: 20 seeds; resample dev+validation with replacement; fixed hyperparameters; evaluate fixed test/company-disjoint

primary_metric: macro F1 on the test split and on the company-disjoint test subset
primary_positive_criterion: 95% CI of the difference vs always-above excludes 0 on both test and company-disjoint
boundaries: The primary metric is macro F1 because the v4 test distribution is class-imbalanced.
Company-disjoint accuracy and selective accuracy may trade off against macro F1; this must be reported, not hidden.
The features are real and point-in-time; outcomes enter history only when their outcome date is before the cutoff.
The model is a simple evidence model; it is not a reader or an answer-level QA system.
The controlled preliminary signal is a separate synthetic mechanism result and is not part of this real benchmark.
